Firme Coding · Open Source · v0.3.0

The people's tutor.

An embeddable AI tutor widget that asks instead of tells. Built for learners who've never had access to one-on-one instruction — powered by Socratic dialogue, gamified progress, and a curriculum you control.

npm install thepplbot
npm · firmecoding.org · MIT License · React 18+

What it does

Three views. One widget.

Drop in a single React component and get a full AI tutoring experience — curriculum-driven, Socratic, and gamified out of the box.

💬
Socratic Chat

The tutor never just gives the answer. Every session is a dialogue — the AI asks what the learner doesn't understand, then guides them toward the answer themselves.

⌨️
Typing Drills

Curriculum-generated writing prompts with XP rewards. Learners practice real-world tasks — emails, messages, forms — with feedback shaped by the module they're in.

📈
Progress Tracking

Level system, XP per drill, module unlocks. Learners can see exactly where they are and how far they've come — designed for people who rarely feel progress in a classroom.

🧩
Custom Curriculum

Pass your own curriculum as a prop. Any subject, any sequence. Firme Coding uses it for digital fluency; you can use it for onboarding, workforce dev, or adult ed.

🔒
Proxy-First API

Your Claude API key stays on your server. The widget calls your proxy endpoint, which relays to Claude. No keys exposed client-side, no CORS headaches.

📱
iOS-Style UI

Frosted glass, segmented controls, spring motion. Designed to feel like an app your learners already trust, not a generic chat window bolted onto a website.

Get started

Two imports. Done.

Install the package, point it at your proxy, and hand it your curriculum. The widget handles everything else — sessions, XP, Socratic prompting, progress state.

Your proxy receives {module, systemPrompt, messages} and returns {reply}. Swap in any Claude model you want.

App.jsx 
// 1. Install
// npm install thepplbot

import { AITutor } from "thepplbot"
import { firmeCurriculum } from
  "thepplbot/curriculum-french-quarter"

export default function App() {
  return (
    <AITutor
      proxyUrl="/api/tutor"
      curriculum={firmeCurriculum}
      userId="learner-001"
      primaryColor="#E8600A"
      accentColor="#5B2D8E"
    />
  )
}

// Your proxy (any runtime):
// POST /api/tutor
// receives { module, systemPrompt, messages }
// returns  { reply }

The why

"I want to normalize — yes, I went to prison. I did my time. Now let's work on our goal."

— Maria Martinez, Founder & Executive Director, Firme Coding

Firme Coding exists because reentry programs kept funneling people into the same narrow lane — arts, social work, cosmetology. All valid, but not the only path. Tech is a path too, and people coming home deserve a seat in that room.

thepplbot is the AI tutor that Firme uses in the classroom. Built on the belief that the best learning happens when the tutor asks the right question, not when they just hand over the answer.

Maria built the curriculum, ran the classes, saw what worked. The package is the result of that — open source so anyone building for learners who've been overlooked can use it.
